T2_padding_diagnostic.note: decode runs under cudagraph replay with padding enabled (disable_cuda_graph_padding=False); realized B is padded up to the next captured size, so the executed batch -- and the traffic B*c -- is a STEP function of realized B.

T2_threshold_feasibility.note: prereg D1 threshold R>=1.5 with R = S(B_hi)/S(B_lo). Under the prereg's own proportional model (k=0) R equals dw(B_hi)/dw(B_lo) exactly, so the threshold is only reachable if the dw ratio itself clears 1.5.

T5_predictor_competition.note: all predictors are deterministic monotone functions of the same design variable B; a good fit of dw is not evidence that weight share is the mechanism

T6_PC1_anchor_check.note: C2's own headline used a DIFFERENT B per arm (T8 at B=12, Ha8 at B=9). prereg PC1 fixes B~9 for both, where T8 is at/below the band edge -> abort risk from an arm/B mismatch, not from a setup error.

VERDICT.status: DESIGN PRE-ANALYSIS ONLY -- no performance verdict, no policy claim
VERDICT.gate21_unscoreable_cells: reported as UNSCOREABLE, never folded into pass/fail

findings.F1_k_not_identified: |k| ~ 0.06-0.08 in every fit; sign flips with the single B=1 point; CI covers 0 in 3 of 4 fits -> ratio-based D1 is not defensible
findings.F2_D1_verdict_is_choice_dependent: same dataset yields SUPPORTED (B 7->16), REFUTED (B 9->16) and UNDETERMINED (B 7->15, 9->15) with non-overlapping CIs
findings.F3_threshold_unreachable_at_low_B: under k=0 (H_weight's own model) R equals dw(hi)/dw(lo); 9->16 = 1.446 and 12->24 = 1.455, both below the 1.5 threshold
findings.F4_non_identification: log B and dw_padded fit S(B) at least as well as dw (R2 0.981/0.982 vs 0.973); with 4 points the design cannot separate 'weight share' from any monotone-in-B cause
findings.F5_B_confounded_with_prefill: mean co-resident prefill batch falls 15 -> 5 as B goes 1 -> 16; realized split partition implies prefill co-residency (97-99%)
findings.F6_reachability: B>=24 exists in 30 decode-active snapshots repo-wide; B>=40 in zero; engine cap 48 (max_running_requests, Ha8 mamba slots)
findings.F7_only_44_to_92_fires: 16->44 has 2 scoreable B points, 16->92 has 1; 44->92 has 5
findings.F8_job_effect_bounded: between-campaign shift at matched (arm,SM,B): mean +0.0001, sd 0.0052 in log ITL
